과거 승선했던 선종이 대상 선박과 같은지: Whether the crew member's past ship types match the target vessel's type
과거 승선했던 선박 총톤수와 대상 선박의 근접도: How close the gross tonnage of the crew member's past vessels is to the target vessel
과거 승선했던 선박의 항로와 대상 선박 항로 일치 여부: Whether the routes of the crew member's past vessels match the target vessel's route
확정된 승선평가 점수 평균: Average of confirmed boarding evaluation scores
누적 승선 기간(연 단위, 체감 반영): Cumulative boarding period (in years, perceptually weighted)
지금 그 직급인지가 아니라, 실제 그 직급으로 승선해본 연차(체감 반영): Years actually boarded at that exact rank, not just currently holding it (perceptually weighted)
마지막 하선일로부터 90일 지났을 때 최고점: Highest score once 90 days have passed since the last sign-off date
선원이 등록한 희망일과 목표 승선일의 근접도: How close the crew member's registered desired date is to the target boarding date
같은 선박 승선 경험이 최고점, 없으면 같은 플릿, 그것도 없으면 같은: Highest score for experience on the same vessel, then the same fleet, then the same owner
30대(30~39세)가 최고점, 멀어질수록 감점: Highest score in the 30s (ages 30-39), with points deducted the further away
로테이션 승선 후보를 추천할 때 각 요소를 얼마나 중요하게 볼지 정합니다: Sets how much weight to give each factor when recommending rotation boarding candidates. These are relative weights, so the total doesn't need to equal 100 — the "out of 100" value next to each one converts the current inputs to a 100-point scale for reference only. The actual fitness score is always calculated on a 0-100 scale regardless of the total.
